name: Rust or Bust!
summary: A desktop application that automates metal surface analysis for the UVA Materials Science Department.
highlights: Engineered a desktop application using Agile Development methodologies for the UVA Materials Science Department, automating metal surface analysis and achieving 99% accuracy in pitting detection.
Constructed computer vision pipelines in Python and OpenCV that generated rust/corrosion visualizations 25–30% faster than manual laboratory processing.
